security.accountSettings.copyConfirmText: The per-account settings of «{name}» (ghost mode, exceptions, delayed sending, protected chats and so on) will replace this account's. Folders are not taken over: the other account has its own.
security.accountSettings.footer: Ghost mode with its exceptions, delayed sending, protected chats, the secret folder and other chat lists are kept per account. Every other Ghostgram setting is shared by all accounts.
security.accounts.headerButtonInfo: The next account's avatar in the header: tap to switch, long press for the account list
security.accounts.switchAuthInfo: A check before any account switch, shared by all accounts
security.auth.noPasscodeText: The device has no passcode and no Telegram passcode is set, so the protection has nothing to check. Set a passcode in Settings › Privacy and Security › Passcode.
security.chatLock.autolockInfo: One check opens every protected chat until the app has been in the background longer than the timer
security.chatLock.footer: Each account has its own list of protected chats; the lock itself and auto-lock are shared. The text of protected chats is not shown in the chat list, search, notifications, banners, the widget or Siri.
security.chatLock.keywords: chat passcode lock face id touch id
security.chatLock.toggleInfo: Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode before a chat opens
security.folder.deleted: The secret folder was deleted in Telegram — choose another one
security.folder.footer: A locked folder disappears from the tabs, the swipe and folder pickers. It opens only from here, with Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode, and locks again when the app goes to the background. Each account chooses its own folder.
security.folder.noFolders: This account has no chat folders
security.folder.protectChatsInfo: While the folder is locked its chats are protected everywhere: All Chats, search, notifications
security.passcode.footer: Auto-lock values are chosen in the menu of the Passcode screen and written once, when chosen.
security.passcode.lockNowInfo: The same as the lock in the Chats header
security.passcode.lockOnLaunchInfo: The passcode is asked on every cold start, even if the auto-lock time has not passed
security.passcode.moreAutolockInfo: 2, 10, 15, 30 minutes, 2, 8 and 24 hours in the auto-lock menu
security.screenshot.footer: On screenshots and screen recordings the chat's header, input field, the panels above it and the buttons come out empty; the messages stay. The account switch check and these options are shared by all accounts.
security.screenshot.toggleInfo: The chat's header, input and panels stay out of screenshots
